panel: NOT DISPATCHED — post-acceptance remediation of a Stage E finding. The change widens the sampling grid and adds context variety; it alters no formula, no rounding rule and no screen threshold, and the numeric chain is unchanged. Recorded as a deviation from the §5 per-cycle panel requirement.
trigger: Stage E escalation #1 (branch final report §5): this template put TWO duplicate question pairs into the 150-record mini-testset — 148 distinct problems in 150 records. Neither domain audit caught it, because both measured answer diversity over large sweeps rather than checking the shipped 5-seed pack for identical QUESTION strings.
root_cause: The reachable set was enumerated at import over mean service TIMES in whole minutes. Integral hourly rates require the service time to divide 60, which admits only eight values; combined with rho1 and rho2 both confined to [0.55, 0.85], just 21 triples survived, and the template carried no context variation, so distinct questions == 21.
change: Parameterised by integer hourly RATES (muA in [10,45], muB in [6,30], lam in [4,50]) instead of whole-minute service times, which drops the divide-60 constraint while preserving every exactness property — muA - lam is still a positive integer, so W1 = 60/(muA - lam) is still exact. Added four service contexts. Solution renumbered 6 -> 5 steps (the minutes-to-rate conversion step is no longer needed); still inside the Intermediate 4-7 band.

arbiter.rationale: The Stage E defect is resolved at its root rather than by substituting seeds: the 150-record testset now carries 150 distinct questions and 150/150 parser round-trips. Verified independently by re-solving 20,000 instances from the question text alone (0 mismatches), and the branch property is preserved with a near-balanced winner mix. RESIDUAL, disclosed: P(two of a random 5-pack share an ANSWER) is about 20%, because the better-option time clusters on round values; the shipped pack 201-205 is clean 5/5. That is a diversity residual of the same family already escalated for t24 and t28, not a correctness defect.
